evidence_boundary.untouched_evidence: a later independently frozen corpus or a new content-addressed OANDA LIVE zero-order shadow arm
evidence_boundary.anti_selection: USD_JPY-only and session-only variants observed in prior diagnostics are not members of this family; they may be preregistered only as N+1

split.boundary_contract: all open lots liquidate on the last completed M5 inside their owning split; no feature, decision, fill, mark, or exit may cross the split

chronology.provider_timestamp: OANDA candle time is the candle-open timestamp
chronology.aggregation: only exact contiguous completed M5 bars are aggregated into UTC-aligned M15, H1, and H4 bars
chronology.decision: M15 bar close after all three constituent M5 bars complete
chronology.entry: first source M5 open whose timestamp is strictly greater than decision_time; LONG uses ASK and SHORT uses BID
chronology.exit: fixed finite max-age close, split-boundary liquidation when earlier, LONG at BID and SHORT at ASK
chronology.gap_policy: a missing five-minute step from decision through exit makes the trade DATA_GAP_UNSCORABLE

features.prices: BID/ASK midpoint for prediction features; executable sides only after signal creation
features.h1_compression: latest completed H1 true range divided by H1 close is at or below pair calibration Q35
features.h4_extension: absolute H4 close-minus-EMA12 divided by H4 ATR6 is at or above pair calibration Q65
features.h1_deceleration: absolute latest H1 log return is below the immediately prior absolute H1 log return
features.pullback_reclaim: H4 and H1 aligned side; previous M15 close is beyond EMA4 against that side and current completed M15 close reclaims EMA4
features.break_acceptance: two completed M15 closes hold beyond the prior eight-bar high/low in the aligned H4/H1 side
features.sweep_reclaim: completed M15 high/low pierces the prior eight-bar rail then closes back inside in the proposed side
features.usd_star: four-M15-bar USD-oriented return mean across EUR_USD, AUD_USD, USD_JPY; non-JPY USD quote pairs are sign-inverted
features.usd_residual: pair USD-oriented four-M15 return minus the three-pair USD-star mean
features.graph_recoupling: absolute residual at or above pair calibration Q65, H1 direction agrees with USD-star direction, and M15 sweep-reclaim agrees with the implied pair side

diagnostic_reference.source: prior fixed 10-cell opened-data diagnostic, not evidence and not a config-selection override
diagnostic_reference.finding: the only cell with positive tuning and development BASE point estimates was H4-direction plus M15 break rejection/reversal at eight hours
diagnostic_reference.disconfirmation: tuning five-day block-bootstrap LCB was -12.399 pips/day; C4/C5 must therefore be selected or rejected by this V3 family contract, not presumed profitable

execution_arms.RAW_SIGNAL: mid open to mid close, zero spread/slippage/fee
execution_arms.EXECUTABLE_BASE: observed BID/ASK plus 0.3 pip slippage per side
execution_arms.ADVERSE_STRESS: same signal and path plus 0.9 pip slippage per side

costs.financing: not modeled; this is an explicit limitation for positions crossing rollover

portfolio.jpy_conversion: JPY-quoted PnL direct; USD-quoted PnL uses the latest completed USD_JPY midpoint at or before the mark

selection.cluster: UTC decision date x four-hour bucket x shared USD currency node
selection.lcb: cluster mean minus z_(1-0.05/8) times standard error across cluster means
selection.all_nonpositive_lcb: retain the best diagnostic configuration as rejected; do not reselect using BASE or ADVERSE

future_evidence.full_month_target: normal and adverse each at least 2.0 equity multiple; never a tuning objective
